title: SpongeBob Cosmic Odyssey
description: SpongeBob SquarePants is depicted as an angelic figure with large golden wings, flying dynamically through a swirling cosmic vortex. He holds a glowing trident while surrounded by floating objects including a drum kit, wooden planks, gold bars, ghostly figures, and a starry attic skylight above.
